Select molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), molecule_name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_records to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1136837'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
